description: Check the OODS Foundry process behind these tools: its status, package version and uptime, registry counts (components, objects, traits), the built brands, themes and token scopes, and the retained proof summaries, each naming the release it measured. Use it first, to learn the pinned version; use catalog_list, object_registry or registry_snapshot instead to read what the counts describe. includeChangelog adds the DSL changelog, and sinceVersion, given with it, keeps only the entries after that version. Read-only and never cached: uptime and latency are this call’s. Host folder paths are omitted.

includeChangelog.description: When true, include DSL version changelog in the response.

sinceVersion.description: When provided with includeChangelog, only return changelog entries since this version.

name: health_check
title: Check Health
